proposal.root_cause: Commit 2df2f7a0dad677ed7f4e342fa5eb0de1f4b23e1b renamed the api Service from 'api' to 'api-svc', breaking DNS resolution of the 'api' upstream used by the frontend nginx config, causing nginx to exit 1 and the pod to CrashLoopBackOff.
proposal.rationale: Pod frontend-569fc5874c-k5qsc is CrashLoopBackOff: previous container logs show 'nginx: [emerg] host not found in upstream "api" in /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:7' (exit code 1). The frontend-nginx ConfigMap (deploy/demo/configmaps.yaml) proxies /api/ to http://api:8000/, so nginx requires a Service named 'api' to resolve at startup. Commit 2df2f7a0dad677ed7f4e342fa5eb0de1f4b23e1b ("deploy(api): rename service") renamed the api Service from 'api' to 'api-svc' in deploy/demo/api.yaml; the cluster confirms only 'api-svc' exists in namespace demo, so DNS for 'api' fails and nginx exits. Restoring the Service name to 'api' (the last known good value from that commit's diff) fixes the upstream resolution without touching the frontend ConfigMap.
proposal.verify: After Argo CD syncs the patch, Service 'api' exists in namespace demo with a ready endpoint (api-svc disappears), nginx starts successfully in pod frontend-*, readiness probe on port 80 succeeds, and the pod becomes Ready with no CrashLoopBackOff restarts.
